positions.locationName: Stevens Point, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language) · Redis · Web Development · Linux · Content Management Systems (CMS)

positions.title: Training and Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Researched and resolved software related issues submitted by customers
•	Trained customers on the purpose, usage, and configuration of various SIS software modules
•	Diffused difficult customer situations through creative troubleshooting 
•	Built and maintained customer relationships through two-way communication channels
• Assisted customers with the setup, configuration, and troubleshooting of data integrations utilizing API implementations and file extracts
• Created, updated, and maintained software documentation and training materials

positions.title: Sales Consultant (Retail)
positions.description:
•	Tended to customer needs both in person and over the phone
•	Expanded business through the sales process
•	Educated customers on various products and their usage
•	Managed inventory through shipping, receiving, and stocking

positions.title: Adjunct Lecturer - Public Speaking
positions.description:
• Instructed both traditional and non-traditional students on public speaking
• Worked collaboratively with a team to develop and coordinate group activities
• Promoted individual and group improvement through continuous evaluation, guidance, and feedback
• Maintained student confidentiality when handling sensitive records, files, and conversations
• Managed the educational program through ongoing development, implementation, and maintenance
• Provided leadership through out-of-the-box thinking in resolving course related issues

positions.title: Travel Assistance Coordinator
positions.description:
• Served as primary contact for customers in a fast-paced communication environment
• Connected customers with internal and external agents in fulfillment of customer needs
• Coordinated the resolution of complex situations working as a liaison between customers and agencies
• Maintained secure records and files documenting interactions with diverse groups of people

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Ensured member programs met fiscal and programmatic goals and objectives through analysis of
reports on key-performance indicators
• Advised leadership of budget recommendations for member programs based on performance
• Acted as liaison between diverse member programs and leadership

• Evaluated the efficacy of marketing and promotional materials to determine best practices
• Followed the development of new marketing and promotional material from idea to implementation
• Ensured compliance of materials with institutional policy and technical restrictions
